v1_governance_baseline.revision_history: Often batched post-session — gaps and missed entries

governance_automation_score.automation_level: FULL — integrity sweep, backup protocol, batch-cap enforcement, and drift detection all automated. Human intervention limited to plan approval (orchestrator manifest sign-off).

verdict: GOVERNANCE_AUTOMATION_EFFECTIVE — The v2 pipeline eliminated manual governance overhead. 10 automated integrity checks replaced hours of manual cross-referencing. Backup protocol enforced automatically. REVISION_HISTORY.md entries written contemporaneously. Governance guard remained at 27/27 PASS throughout. In v1, these same governance activities consumed 30-50% of session time (counting, drift detection, artifact cross-referencing). In v2, they ran in sub-second at session close.
